home.title: Technical foundation
home.subtitle: Phase 1 — everything on this page goes through the full stack: renderer → typed IPC → services → SQLite.
home.localApiStopped: stopped (local-api flag disabled — restart after enabling)

chat.title: Assistant
chat.placeholder: Ask for an action or a question…
chat.empty: Describe what you want to build: the assistant can create nodes, wire them, write prompts and launch generations right in the workflow.
chat.homeEmpty: Describe the project you want: the assistant creates the project and video, picks the art direction and builds the whole workflow. E.g. “Create a 2.5-minute anime project about…”
chat.needKey: Add your kie.ai API key in Integrations on the home page to enable the assistant.
chat.fixPromptPrefill:
The generation of node “{{label}}” failed with: {{error}}
Analyze this node's prompt, fix it to avoid that error while staying true to the intent, update the node, then relaunch the generation.
chat.adjustPromptPrefill:
The output of node “{{label}}” doesn't work for me: 

Improve the prompt accordingly, update the node, then relaunch the generation.
